verdict.rationale: Drata's docs say it automates evidence collection from connected systems, including on-premise tools and custom workflows, and offers control and evidence monitoring and monitoring tests. Its endpoint agent reads security settings such as screensaver locking, antivirus and automatic updates, which replaces manual checks. However, the evidence never shows collection running on a recurring schedule or producing timestamped artifacts, and one community comment notes screenshot uploads remain an alternative to the agent. missing for 10: documented recurring collection schedule, timestamped machine-gathered artifacts, explicit replacement of screenshots/CSV exports, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Connect on-premise tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection.
